annotations.text:
Headline on its own ground, video panel bleeding off the right edge — no type sitting on a photograph, so the contrast fight disappears.

Video: preload="none", script-started. Zero bytes until it is wanted.

Two directions for the portrait moment — both do the same thing: severe at rest, warm on hover or press.

A: hard light, dark ground, cold grey to warm.
B: line engraving that redraws into a photograph, on cream.

Pick one; the other gets deleted.
All copy here is your real, indexed text. Anything in [BRACKETS] is a placeholder for a fact I do not have.
